name: bubbly
description: Bubbly – local AI coding agent (web + desktop)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.desktop: npm run build:all && cd desktop && npm start
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && npm run icons && cd desktop && npm run dist
